title: DepthCrackNet: A Deep Learning Model for Automatic Pavement Crack Detection
summary: DepthCrackNet is a learned image-segmentation model for pavement cracks, with comparisons against annotated images. Results reports crack detection/segmentation performance on held-out imagery; new bounded infrastructure-imaging capability.
